newsitem.title: USA: Employee Solutions named in holder suit.
newsitem.headline: Employee Solutions named in holder suit.

text.p: The law firm of Berger & Montague said Wednesday it filed a shareholder lawsuit seeking class action status against Employee Solutions Inc and on behalf of shareholders of the company.
The law firm said it filed the lawsuit in a federal court in Arizona. It said it was joined by the law firm of Bonnet, Fairbourn, Friedman & Balint in representing shareholders in the lawsuit.
The lawsuit is similar to one previously filed by Wolf Popper LP and Bonnet, Hairbourn & Friedman and announced on March 18.
The latest complaint was filed on behalf of buyers of Employee Solutions' common shares between November 14, 1995 and March 14, 1997, lawyers for the plaintiffs said.

The complaint charged the company and certain senior officers with violation of antifraud provisions of federal securities laws for allegedly materially misrepresenting the company's financial condition, including the adequacy of its loss reserves. The lawsuit alleges that more than $13 million of the company's stock was unloaded by insiders, including three of the defendants, between November 1995 and the middle of last month.
